post.summary: Request a URL to upload your content to
post.description:
This API requires at least four calls - initiate, upload, status, download. This page describes all of these except the upload, which is straightforward and detailed in the initiate response.
### Steps required
1. Send a simple JSON request to this endpoint, which will return an `upload` link and a `status` link. Please see the Links section on the Async Documentation page for more detail.
2. Upload your file to the `upload` link
3. Periodically request the `status` until it is `complete`, which will include a `result` link
4. Download your new file from the `result` link

x-codeSamples.source:
#!/bin/bash
curl \
--request POST \
--url '${URL}/initiate' \
--header 'content-type: application/json' \
--header 'x-api-key: ABC----YOUR_APIKEY----789' \
--data '{"mime-type":"application/octet-stream", "options": { "conversion": { "from": { "mime-type": "application/msword" }}}}' \
--fail

# and then upload, based on values from status return from above

#!/bin/bash
curl \
--request POST \
--url '${URL}/initiate' \
--header 'content-type: application/json' \
--header 'x-api-key: ABC----YOUR_APIKEY----789' \
--data '{"mime-type":"application/pdf"}' \
--fail

# and then upload, based on values from status return from above

curl \
--request '[links.upload.method]' \
--url '[links.upload.url]' \
# recreate all headers from links.upload.headers
--header 'name1: value1' \
--data '{"mime-type":"application/pdf"}'
--upload-file 'unsafe-document.pdf' \
--fail

#!/bin/bash
curl \
--request POST \
--url '${URL}/initiate' \
--header 'content-type: application/json' \
--header 'x-api-key: ABC----YOUR_APIKEY----789' \
--data '{"mime-type":"application/octet-stream", "options": { "risks": { "allow": [ "exe/macro/ms/word" ]}}}' \
--fail

# and then upload, based on values from status return from above

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of your operation
get.description:
Status calls are required, unless you use SNS integration.

If a further status request is required (`complete` is not `true`), the `links` property will contain `status`.
> All requests should be constructed using the details in `links.status`

parameters.description: All of the query parameters from the download link should be maintained

get.summary: Download the result of your operation
get.description:
After successful processing, `links.result` will point to here. You may only download the result once.
> All requests should be constructed using the details in `links.result`

x-codeSamples.source:
#!/bin/bash
curl \
--request '[links.result.method]' \
--url '[links.result.url]' \
# recreate all headers from links.result.headers
--header 'name1: value1' \
--output 'safe-document.pdf' \
--fail
